newsitem.title: USA: Continental Airlines sets warrant purchase.
newsitem.headline: Continental Airlines sets warrant purchase.

text.p: Continental Airlines said on Thursday that Air Partners LP exercised its previously announced right to sell to Continental $50 million of warrants to purchase Class B common stock issued earlier by Continental.
The $50 million is in intrinsic value, which is the current Class B common stock price minus the exercise price.
As a result, Continental said it will purchase, for $50 million in cash, warrants to buy 2,614,379 Class B shares at an exercise price of $7.50 per share. The transaction will close early next week.
Air Partners continues to be the company's largest stockholder, Continental said.
